questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C). Gopal Krishna Gokhale was born on May 9, 1866, in Rat- nagiri (Maharashtra). He graduated from Elphinston College in 1884 and was appointed a professor of Political economy and History at Ferguson College in Poona. Gokhale became as a protege of social reformer Mahadev Govind Ranade. He was a member of the Deccan Education Society. Gokhale fought for decades to obtain greater political representation and power over public affairs for common Indian. He ﬁ rst joined Congress in 1889 at the Bombay session. Gokhale became a member of the Bombay Legislative Council and then the Impe- rial Legislative Council. Gandhiji often referred to Gokhale as ‘Mahatma.’ He was the political mentor of Gandhiji.

questions.questionTextEn: At which session was the Indian National Congress (INC) divided into two groups –’Naram Dal’ and Ga- ram Dal’?

questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B). The Indian National Congress was formed in 1885 and was divided into two fractions in 1907, namely extremists– Garam Dal led by Lala Lajpat Rai and moderates ‘Naram Dal’ led by Ras Bihari Ghosh. Ras Bihari Ghosh succeeded to become its President. Reason of this division was four Resolution Swadeshi, Boycot, National Education and self-Rule which passed in 1906 in Calcutta session. Extremists wanted to continue this resolution while the liberals were not in favour.
questions.explanationHi: सही उत्तर: (B) भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस का गठन 1885 में हुआ था और 1907 में इसे दो भागों में विभाजित किया गया था, अर्थात् उग्रवादी- लाला लाजपत राय के नेतृत्व वाला गरम दल और रास बिहारी घोष के नेतृत्व वाला नरम दल। रासबिहारी घोष इसके अध्यक्ष बनने में सफल हुए। इस विभाजन का कारण चार संकल्प स्वदेशी, बहिष्कार, राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा और स्वशासन थे जो 1906 में कलकत्ता अधिवेशन में पारित हुए। उग्रवादी इस प्रस्ताव को जारी रखना चाहते थे जबकि उदारवादी इसके पक्ष में नहीं थे।
